description: Discover publisher section labels across the indexed corpus, distinct-site counts, newly observed labels, conservative emerging signals and seven-day membership changes. Emerging requires ten estimated domain-name families, excludes known templates/duplicates and waits three days; this measures index observations, not adoption. Labels come from headings, not a fixed taxonomy. Heading presence describes content and does not certify a capability. Partial coverage and baseline status are reported.

action.description: Actions are inferred from publisher content. They can overlap and do not prove a working integration, authorization or task success. Unclassified sites may be missing useful actions.

country.description: Country: owner-declared or site-published address preferred; domain/hosting inference is a labeled fallback. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (XK supported), case-insensitive, or unknown. GET /v1/countries / list_countries lists counts. Not verified headquarters or markets served.

page.description: Page number. Public discovery has no automatic result-window quota; each page holds at most 100 records.

sections.description: Publisher section keys from list_sections; discovered dynamically from indexed headings.
